description: This Java source file contains the main activity for an Android wearable application called Jumping Jack. It manages sensor interactions to detect jump motions, updates UI with a counter, handles activity lifecycle events, and maintains a screen-on timer.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity that detects jump movements using the gravity sensor on an Android wearable device, manages UI fragments, and maintains persistence of jump count.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up views, registers sensor, and restores previous counter value.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Configures the view pager, indicators, and event listeners for page changes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listener when activity pauses.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Processes gravity sensor data to detect jump movements.

methods.name: onAccuracyChanged
methods.description: Placeholder for handling sensor accuracy changes (not used).

methods.name: detectJump
methods.description: Implements logic to detect up or down hand movement based on gravity sensor readings.

methods.name: onJumpDetected
methods.description: Increments counter and updates UI when a complete jump movement is detected.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Updates UI, saves counter to preferences, and vibrates device on milestone.

methods.name: renewTimer
methods.description: Resets and restarts timer to keep screen on.

methods.name: resetFlag
methods.description: Clears the keep screen on flag and finishes activity after timeout.

methods.name: setIndicator
methods.description: Updates page indicator visuals based on current page.
